name: Payment Mandate
description: Payment mandate authorizing a grantee to execute payment requests on behalf of a granter, under explicit limits, with deterministic spend tracking and optional linked PayNote bootstrap rules.

granteeChannel.description: Grantee timeline channel (party allowed to use the mandate).

guarantorChannel.description: Bank/admin channel executing mandate checks and settlement updates.

authorizeSpend.description: Validate a charge attempt against mandate policy and reserve capacity.

expr.value: Amount must be greater than zero.
Currency does not match mandate currency.
Counterparty is not allowed by mandate.

settleSpend.description: Apply final reserve/capture deltas for a previously authorized charge attempt.

expr.value: capturedDeltaMinor must be 0 for failed settlement.

granterType.description:
Party granting authority to use funds:
- merchant
- customer

granterId.description:
Identifier of the granting party:
- merchantId when granterType is merchant
- customerId (bank user id) when granterType is customer

granteeType.description:
Party allowed to invoke this mandate:
- documentId
- merchantId
- customerId

amountLimit.description: Maximum amount in minor currency units allowed by this mandate.

currency.description: Currency code used for amountLimit validation.

amountReserved.description: Running reserved amount in minor currency units. Increased after successful reserve/authorize, decreased after release/capture.

amountCaptured.description: Running captured amount in minor currency units. Increased after successful capture.

sourceAccount.description: Funds source to use when this mandate executes: - root (uses root account context; for merchant this maps to active credit line) - specific account number

revokedAt.description: Optional revocation timestamp. When set, mandate is inactive.

allowLinkedPayNote.description: Whether this mandate allows linked PayNote startup after charge execution.

allowedPayNotes.description: Optional linked PayNote allowlist. Used only when allowLinkedPayNote is true. Missing list means wildcard (any linked PayNote is allowed). Each entry must set exactly one selector: typeBlueId or documentBlueId.

typeBlueId.description: Optional blue-id of an allowed PayNote type. Mutually exclusive with documentBlueId.

documentBlueId.description: Optional blue-id of an allowed concrete PayNote document. Mutually exclusive with typeBlueId.

allowedPaymentCounterparties.description: Optional payment counterparty allowlist. Missing list means wildcard (any counterparty is allowed).

counterpartyType.description:
Allowed payment counterparty identifier type:
- merchantId
- customerId
- accountNumber

counterpartyId.description: Counterparty identifier interpreted according to counterpartyType.

chargeAttempts.description: Stateful map of authorizationId -> authorization state (authorization + settlement).

amountMinor.description: Requested amount in minor currency units.

counterpartyId.description: Counterparty identifier interpreted according to counterpartyType.

authorizedAmountMinor.description: Authorized amount reserved against mandate capacity for this attempt.

settled.description: Whether mandate accepted settlement for this attempt.

lastSettlementRequestStatus.description: Last settlement request status received from bank ("succeeded" | "failed").

lastSettlementProcessingStatus.description: Mandate processing status for last settlement ("accepted" | "rejected").

settlementRespondedAt.description: Timestamp of last settlement processing response.

reservedDeltaMinor.description: Reserved delta applied for accepted settlement.

capturedDeltaMinor.description: Captured delta applied for accepted settlement.

holdId.description: Optional hold id associated with settlement.

transactionId.description: Optional transaction id associated with settlement.

lastSettlementId.description: Optional last applied settlement id for idempotency tracking.
